protocol.name: source_calibrated_domain_shift_sentinel
protocol.target_usage: Scored only after source-only method and threshold freeze
protocol.target_label_usage: Final classifier metrics and benign/malicious diagnostics only

guarded_operational_outputs.interpretation: DOMAIN_SHIFT_DETECTED is a deployment interlock, not a malicious prediction; withheld errors are not counted as detected attacks.

domain_shift.scope_note: The sentinel detects batch-level domain mismatch. It neither labels the cause as malicious nor repairs target classifier performance.

notes: Feature bins, reference histograms, and the alarm threshold use source data only.
Source calibration and audit windows are disjoint and label-blind.
Target capping and mixed-window construction do not consult target labels.
Benign-only and malicious-only target windows are retrospective diagnostics.
DOMAIN_SHIFT_DETECTED is not counted as an attack detection.
Canonical source files were previously capped per binary class and do not preserve native prevalence.
